parsed.title: Context Memory Boost
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock 15 minutes of 5x context memory via a rewarded mini-game.
parsed.trigger: When the user lands on the memory paywall screen (s03) and is blocked from advanced context.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users reaching the memory wall.

offer.title: Unlock Memory Boost
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 5x context memory for the next 15 minutes.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 15 minutes and capped at 2 uses per day, ensuring the Janitor Plus subscription (of1) remains the only way to get permanent memory [TAX-2] [CANN-2].
risks: Increased inference costs, mitigated by using a cost-optimized text-cheap model for the 15-minute boost session [TRIG-4].
Potential devaluation of the Janitor Plus subscription if frequent usage satisfies core roleplay sessions.

evidence.quote: Access advanced chat memory and priority is blocked
